description: Healthy SvelteKit project that exercises the server/client/shared boundary: +server.ts API endpoint, +page.server.ts data loader, +page.svelte client view, +page.ts universal load. Server-side files share server-only utilities under $lib/server, page components share universal $lib/format. Verifies the +server/+page.server/.server/.client conventions are honored without rsc-leak false positives.
